changes: Cup standings during the race: During the race a small panel shows the cup standings as they would be if the race ended now: the leader, the drivers just ahead of and behind you, and your points.
Your race length: Choose your race length from 8 to 90 minutes and a free practice of 15, 30 or 60 minutes before qualifying.
Skip circuits you don't like: Pick circuits you never want to race on.
Multi-class races: Two new multi-class cups: GT Endurance with GT3 and GT4 cars at International level and Pro Endurance with prototypes and GT3 cars at Pro level.
